children: As India and New Zealand celebrate 100 years of sporting ties, New Zealand Cricket (NZC) has named Hero Vida as the Title Sponsor for India’s upcoming tour of New Zealand, the marquee bilateral series of the year.

The 12-match tour, beginning on 22nd October 2026, forms part of New Zealand’s ‘100 Years of Unity through Sport’ programme, a year-long celebration of the sporting relationship between India and New Zealand. The milestone traces back to 1926, when an Indian Army hockey team first toured New Zealand.

Team India will take on the BLACKCAPS across five T20Is, five ODIs and two Tests, making the tour the biggest international and most significant international series for India in the current calendar year.
As Title Sponsor, Hero Vida will hold the naming rights across the full 12-match series, with a prominent presence throughout the tour.

The partnership has been stitched by TCM Sports, New Zealand Cricket’s exclusive naming rights and on-ground partner from 2019 through 2031 and one of the biggest sports marketing companies. A longstanding commercial partner of NZC, TCM Sports has worked closely with the board to bring Hero Vida on board for the landmark series.

On the news, Geoff Allott, CEO, New Zealand Cricket, says, “This is a significant year for sport between India and New Zealand, and we are delighted that this extensive tour will be part of the centenary celebrations. Twelve matches across all three formats underline the scale of the series, and we are pleased to welcome Hero Vida as Title Sponsor for what promises to be a memorable home summer. India’s tours of New Zealand always generate tremendous interest, and we look forward to another highly competitive series between the two sides.”

Sanjay Bhan, Executive Vice President - Global Business, Global Product Planning and Global Market Insights, Hero MotoCorp adds, “Cricket has a remarkable ability to bring people together, transcending borders and creating moments that millions can celebrate together.

We are proud to be the Title Sponsor for India’s tour of New Zealand, marking yet another significant chapter in the sporting relationship between the two nations. This much-anticipated series will see two of the world’s top cricketing teams battle it out across an exhilarating line-up of T20s, ODIs and Test matches.

For Hero Vida, this partnership is an opportunity to associate with a highly anticipated international tournament while celebrating the spirit of movement, ambition and progress—principles deeply rooted in our brand. We look forward to an exciting series that inspires fans across the world and creates many memorable moments, both on and off the field."

Lokesh Sharma, Managing Director, TCM Sports, comments, “Our partnership with New Zealand Cricket has been built over several years and created strong commercial opportunities for its international cricket. This is an especially significant tour, both because of its scale and because it comes in the centenary year of sporting ties between India and New Zealand. We are delighted to have Hero Vida on board as the Title Sponsor and look forward to delivering a strong partnership across the series.”
